# Week 3 Start/Sit — Saturday, Sept 26

## Source and freshness

Primary source: the committed **week-3 fixture** (`weekly-report-week-3.json`, generated **2026-09-23 21:24 UTC** — after the blend/injury-merge/depth-chart fixes). Overlaid with a **live** `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` pull just now: 30 of 32 teams now carry a final Friday designation (111 of 300 rows) — essentially the full injury picture for Sunday's slate. Checked every rostered player by exact ID: only Dart and Bowers carry any row at all, both unchanged from Wednesday. **No changes since the last briefing.**

Current week confirmed as Week 3 via `season_week.py`, cross-checked against the schedule: Thursday's GB@ATL is final (ATL 35–14); the other 14 games are still ahead.

## Start these ten — 123.68 expected points

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | If he plays | P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | vs DEN (Sun 8:20pm) | **14.20** | 14.83 | 95.8% |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs HOU (Sun 1:00pm) | **17.71** | 18.99 | 93.3% |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs MIN (Sun 4:05pm) | **15.88** | 17.02 | 93.3% |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @ WAS (Sun 1:00pm) | **20.53** | 21.51 | 95.5% |
| WR | Tee Higgins | @ PIT (Sun 1:00pm) | **12.50** | 13.09 | 95.5% |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs TEN (Sun 1:00pm) | **10.46** | 11.29 | 92.6% |
| FLEX | Cam Skattebo (RB) | vs TEN (Sun 1:00pm) | **11.76** | 12.61 | 93.3% |
| FLEX | Matthew Golden (WR) | vs ATL — **final** | **11.75**\* | 12.31 | 95.5% |
| K | Cameron Dicker | @ BUF (Sun 1:00pm) | **4.16** | 4.25 | 97.9% |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | @ CHI (Mon 8:15pm) | **4.73** | 4.73 | 100% |

\*Golden already played Thursday and locked in 5/12 for 100 yards and a TD — well above his projection, in a 35–14 loss. Nothing to decide there any more; shown for the record.

**Bench:** Josh Downs (11.39), Drake London (10.82), Jameson Williams (10.57), Brock Bowers (6.19, Questionable), Jaxson Dart (0.03, Out for the season).

## Changes

**None since Wednesday's briefing.** Same lineup, same designations, now confirmed against a materially fuller live injury report (30/32 teams with a final tag, up from 22 rows Wednesday).

## Watch list

- **Brock Bowers** (Questionable, DNP practice, knee) — correctly benched behind Likely (6.19 vs 10.46 expected). Only reopens if he's upgraded before the LV@NO 4:25pm kickoff Sunday; the live feed shows no such upgrade.
- **Jaxson Dart** — this is no longer a start/sit question, it's a roster one. Season-ending knee surgery, P(play) 0.3%. He's still occupying a bench spot instead of IR. **Move him to IR** and grab a streaming QB — Tyler Shough (NO, 17.97-pt consensus vs LV) is the top rostered QB on the waiver list right now.

## Opponent notes

- Likely, Skattebo, and the inactive Dart all share the **NYG vs TEN** game — a bad Giants script costs two active lineup spots at once, not one.
- Higgins is on the road against Pittsburgh's defense; still the clear start, just don't expect a ceiling game.

## Byes ahead

None in Weeks 4–5. Nearest: **Tee Higgins and Jameson Williams, both Week 6** — three weeks out, worth starting to plan around given only 5 bench spots.

## Caveats

- No `generate_report.py` run this time — the fixture was fresh enough per the routine's own rule, so this is a confirmation pass, not a new generation.
- Stafford/Irving/Skattebo/Downs/Higgins/London/Golden/Williams are the in-house estimate tier; Taylor/JSN/Likely/Bowers are FantasyPros consensus. All figures above are **expected points** (P(play) × conditional), never the raw if-he-plays number treated as an expectation.
- Dicker at 4.16 still reads low for a kicker in this league's distance-graded FG bands — flagged again, not re-investigated.
- FLEX2 (Skattebo vs Golden, 11.76 vs 11.75) is inside model noise; Golden's outcome for this week is already locked in regardless.
